fields.statement: At 22cb5a04 read the diff: plan.toml's merge step gains on.fail = rebase, and rebase, wait-rebased, rebased-green and merge each get max_visits = 3. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes; TestPlanBuiltin asserts the merge fail->rebase transition and cap 3 on all four steps. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(plan-workflow-merge-main-moved|plan-workflow|plan-workflow-pr|run-ship-merge-main-moved|describe-golden) -count=1 passes. The new plan-workflow-merge-main-moved.txtar (modelled on run-ship-merge-main-moved) has a fake gh move origin/main once after the first rebased-green; rhiza run status shows merge (visit 1): fail, then rebase: exit 1; rebase (visit 2) pass; rebased-green (visit 2) pass; merge (visit 2): pass, then close-out; close-out pass, no visit 3; gh.log holds exactly one pr merge, 'pr merge 7 --squash --match-head-commit <merged head>', and the merged head descends from the other change set's commit, so rebase visit 2 pushed the rebased head; the run prints succeeded. The commit's .rhiza files are only the builder's own actor record.
